name: detail-D-opening_perimeter-window-GARAGE_WALL_2X6
notes: • Cut at WIN-G-N1; WIN-G-S1 is the same unit. WT-1424-FIX, R.O. 1'-2" x 2'-0", sill 3'-6" above the stem top.
• Wood wall: 2x6 at 24" o.c., 5/8" CDX, 2" of 2 lb closed-cell foam per bay. No WRB.
• Innie: the unit sits in the stud plane, outer face on the CDX. No buck projection, no vent gap.
• Bucks before foam. The bay foam is the air and water plane; the CDX is the membrane substrate.
• Jamb and sill trim are site brakes from 24 ga flat stock; the head is the stock 58114XX.
• No membrane shows: every one lies behind metal (owner, 2026-11-16).
• Head: stock 58114XX on the head membrane, its 2-1/2" back leg stripped in 2" onto the CDX. Sealant under its drip.
• Steel head and trim never touch aluminium: EPDM or sealant between.
K1  Fluid-applied membrane round the R.O., lapped 2" onto the CDX.
K2  Sill pan: 1/4"/ft on a tapered KDAT shim, back dam at the studs' inner face, turned down 3/4" on the CDX behind the sill trim and panel.
